summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the record date for its annual general meeting of shareholders. The filing sets May 22, 2026 as the record date for ordinary shares and American depositary shares to determine eligibility to vote and attend the AGM. This is a routine corporate governance notice with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation. The filing includes details on share transfer deadlines and voting instructions for ADS holders. No deal terms, financial metrics, or strategic changes are disclosed. This is a standard report of a foreign private issuer regarding an annual meeting.
